note_en: The pair 先…，再… sets the order of actions: 先 marks what comes first, 再 what follows. In the text: 先带儿子去社区医院，再赶去市医院陪父亲 "first take her son to the community clinic, then rush to the city hospital to be with her father." Here 再 means "then, next," not "again." The pair also works for advice: 先把病养好，再说写作业的事 "get better first, then we'll talk about homework."
